summary:
Implementation plan for FocusGrove feature upgrades:
- Printable PDF report generation for study logs and activity heatmap data.
- Dual-mode Focus screen with Pomodoro countdown and count-up Stopwatch with lap tracking.
- Custom minute input and quick stepper controls alongside existing timer presets.
- Persistent local storage enhancements ensuring all custom timer settings, stopwatch records, and daily logs persist offline.
